headline: Weathered Expanse Grinds On; Stlican Shelf Line Gives Ground
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse holds its five-to-four Warden-Colonial split, but the fighting there is far from settled: sixty-two base events in the past day, sixteen in six hours, and Warden casualties running near 788 an hour against 573 the hour before. Stlican Shelf has shifted since the last edition, its line now standing two Warden, six Colonial and one square gone to no-man's-land, with eight events in two hours about Breaker Town. Callahan's Passage, so busy in the previous report, has gone quiet in the past two hours, though its day's toll—10,002 Colonial and 13,424 Warden—remains the war's heaviest. Fisherman's Row stays three Warden to six Colonial, three events in the last two hours around Eidolo and Black Well. Nevish Line stirs at Grief Mother and Tomb Father, where Colonial losses are mounting at 439 an hour; Mooring County's fighting has eased to fourteen events a day. Of the fifty-three regions reported, only six carry more than one colour, and Colonial forces hold the great majority of the rest.
